title: 學華語向前走 2A — Lesson 3
description: Vocabulary from lesson 3 of the textbook 學華語向前走 (Let's Learn Mandarin) 2A, with original example sentences written for young beginners (Traditional characters).

exampleSentences.hanzi: 老師，我要喝水。
exampleSentences.pinyin: lǎoshī, wǒ yào hē shuǐ.
exampleSentences.english: Teacher, I want to drink some water.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 你要坐這裡嗎？
exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ yào zuò zhèlǐ ma?
exampleSentences.english: Do you want to sit here?

exampleSentences.hanzi: 放學後，我要去公園玩。
exampleSentences.pinyin: fàngxué hòu, wǒ yào qù gōngyuán wán.
exampleSentences.english: After school, I want to go to the park to play.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 媽媽，我要吃香蕉。
exampleSentences.pinyin: māma, wǒ yào chī xiāngjiāo.
exampleSentences.english: Mum, I want to eat a banana.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 學校附近有一個公園。
exampleSentences.pinyin: xuéxiào fùjìn yǒu yí ge gōngyuán.
exampleSentences.english: There is a park near the school.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我的座位在黑板附近。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de zuòwèi zài hēibǎn fùjìn.
exampleSentences.english: My seat is near the blackboard.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 海灘附近有很多小朋友在堆沙堡。
exampleSentences.pinyin: hǎitān fùjìn yǒu hěn duō xiǎopéngyou zài duī shābǎo.
exampleSentences.english: Lots of kids are building sandcastles near the beach.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 媽媽在校門附近等我。
exampleSentences.pinyin: māma zài xiàomén fùjìn děng wǒ.
exampleSentences.english: Mum waits for me near the school gate.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 超級市場很大。
exampleSentences.pinyin: chāojíshìchǎng hěn dà.
exampleSentences.english: The supermarket is very big.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 超級市場在哪裡？
exampleSentences.pinyin: chāojíshìchǎng zài nǎlǐ?
exampleSentences.english: Where is the supermarket?

exampleSentences.hanzi: 週末媽媽開車帶我去超級市場買菜。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhōumò māma kāichē dài wǒ qù chāojíshìchǎng mǎicài.
exampleSentences.english: On the weekend, Mum drives me to the big supermarket to buy vegetables.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 超級市場的購物車好大，我幫爸爸推。
exampleSentences.pinyin: chāojíshìchǎng de gòuwùchē hǎo dà, wǒ bāng bàba tuī.
exampleSentences.english: The supermarket trolley is so big, and I help Dad push it.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 超市離我家很近。
exampleSentences.pinyin: chāoshì lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn.
exampleSentences.english: The supermarket is very close to my house.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 超市裡有很多水果。
exampleSentences.pinyin: chāoshì lǐ yǒu hěn duō shuǐguǒ.
exampleSentences.english: There is a lot of fruit in the supermarket.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我跟爸爸騎腳踏車去超市，買一袋麵包。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ gēn bàba qí jiǎotàchē qù chāoshì, mǎi yí dài miànbāo.
exampleSentences.english: Dad and I ride our bikes to the little supermarket to buy a bag of bread.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 超市的蘋果很紅，我要選一個最大的。
exampleSentences.pinyin: chāoshì de píngguǒ hěn hóng, wǒ yào xuǎn yí ge zuì dà de.
exampleSentences.english: The apples at the supermarket are so red, I want to pick the biggest one.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 請把東西放好。
exampleSentences.pinyin: qǐng bǎ dōngxi fàng hǎo.
exampleSentences.english: Please put your things away.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 媽媽買了很多東西。
exampleSentences.pinyin: māma mǎi le hěn duō dōngxi.
exampleSentences.english: Mum bought lots of things.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 好吃的東西我都想吃。
exampleSentences.pinyin: hǎochī de dōngxi wǒ dōu xiǎng chī.
exampleSentences.english: I want to eat all the yummy things.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 書包裡裝了好多東西，好重啊！
exampleSentences.pinyin: shūbāo lǐ zhuāng le hǎo duō dōngxi, hǎo zhòng a!
exampleSentences.english: My school bag is full of stuff, so heavy!

exampleSentences.hanzi: 巧克力是甜的。
exampleSentences.pinyin: qiǎokèlì shì tián de.
exampleSentences.english: Chocolate is sweet.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我喜歡吃巧克力。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan chī qiǎokèlì.
exampleSentences.english: I like to eat chocolate.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 踢完足球，我吃了一塊巧克力。
exampleSentences.pinyin: tī wán zúqiú, wǒ chī le yí kuài qiǎokèlì.
exampleSentences.english: After soccer, I ate a piece of chocolate.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 爸爸說，吃太多巧克力會蛀牙。
exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba shuō, chī tài duō qiǎokèlì huì zhùyá.
exampleSentences.english: Dad says eating too much chocolate gives you cavities.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我最喜歡草莓冰淇淋。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ zuì xǐhuan cǎoméi bīngqílín.
exampleSentences.english: My favourite is strawberry ice cream.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 天氣很熱，我想吃冰淇淋。
exampleSentences.pinyin: tiānqì hěn rè, wǒ xiǎng chī bīngqílín.
exampleSentences.english: It's hot, so I want to eat ice cream.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 冰淇淋車來了，我們快跑！
exampleSentences.pinyin: bīngqílín chē lái le, wǒmen kuài pǎo!
exampleSentences.english: The ice-cream van is here, let's run!

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我和弟弟一人一個冰淇淋。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ hé dìdi yí rén yí ge bīngqílín.
exampleSentences.english: My little brother and I each have one ice cream.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我買了一枝鉛筆。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ mǎi le yì zhī qiānbǐ.
exampleSentences.english: I bought a pencil.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 你買了什麼？
exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ mǎi le shénme?
exampleSentences.english: What did you buy?

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我們去買一個新的足球。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen qù mǎi yí ge xīn de zúqiú.
exampleSentences.english: We're going to buy a new soccer ball.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 這個書包是媽媽買的，我很喜歡。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhège shūbāo shì māma mǎi de, wǒ hěn xǐhuan.
exampleSentences.english: Mum bought this school bag, and I really like it.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 牛肉是一種肉。
exampleSentences.pinyin: niúròu shì yì zhǒng ròu.
exampleSentences.english: Beef is a kind of meat.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 媽媽今天煮牛肉。
exampleSentences.pinyin: māma jīntiān zhǔ niúròu.
exampleSentences.english: Mum is cooking beef today.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 爸爸炒的牛肉很香，我吃了兩碗飯。
exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba chǎo de niúròu hěn xiāng, wǒ chī le liǎng wǎn fàn.
exampleSentences.english: Dad's stir-fried beef smells so good, I had two bowls of rice.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我的午餐盒裡有牛肉，我很開心。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de wǔcānhé lǐ yǒu niúròu, wǒ hěn kāixīn.
exampleSentences.english: There is beef in my lunch box, and I'm happy.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我每天吃青菜。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ měitiān chī qīngcài.
exampleSentences.english: I eat green vegetables every day.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 青菜對身體好。
exampleSentences.pinyin: qīngcài duì shēntǐ hǎo.
exampleSentences.english: Vegetables are good for your body.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我們家的花園裡種了青菜。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen jiā de huāyuán lǐ zhòng le qīngcài.
exampleSentences.english: We planted green vegetables in our garden.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我不喜歡吃青菜，但媽媽說要多吃一點。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ bù xǐhuan chī qīngcài, dàn māma shuō yào duō chī yìdiǎn.
exampleSentences.english: I don't like green vegetables, but Mum says I should eat a bit more.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 一包米很重。
exampleSentences.pinyin: yì bāo mǐ hěn zhòng.
exampleSentences.english: A bag of uncooked rice is heavy.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 媽媽先洗米，再煮飯。
exampleSentences.pinyin: māma xiān xǐ mǐ, zài zhǔ fàn.
exampleSentences.english: Mum washes the uncooked rice first, then cooks it.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我幫媽媽把一袋米搬到廚房。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ bāng māma bǎ yí dài mǐ bān dào chúfáng.
exampleSentences.english: I help Mum carry a bag of uncooked rice to the kitchen.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 媽媽用量杯量米，我來按電鍋。
exampleSentences.pinyin: māma yòng liàngbēi liáng mǐ, wǒ lái àn diànguō.
exampleSentences.english: Mum measures the uncooked rice with a cup, and I press the rice cooker button.

words.definition: can, may, possible, be able to

exampleSentences.hanzi: 老師說，我們可以出去玩了。
exampleSentences.pinyin: lǎoshī shuō, wǒmen kěyǐ chūqù wán le.
exampleSentences.english: The teacher says we can go out and play now.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我可以借這本書嗎？
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ kěyǐ jiè zhè běn shū ma?
exampleSentences.english: Can I borrow this book?

exampleSentences.hanzi: 爸爸，我可以帶足球去公園嗎？
exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba, wǒ kěyǐ dài zúqiú qù gōngyuán ma?
exampleSentences.english: Dad, can I take my soccer ball to the park?

exampleSentences.hanzi: 下雨了，不可以在外面踢球。
exampleSentences.pinyin: xiàyǔ le, bù kěyǐ zài wàimiàn tī qiú.
exampleSentences.english: It's raining, so we're not allowed to kick the ball outside.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 糖果很甜。
exampleSentences.pinyin: tángguǒ hěn tián.
exampleSentences.english: Candy is very sweet.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 老師說，上課的時候不要吃糖果。
exampleSentences.pinyin: lǎoshī shuō, shàngkè de shíhou bú yào chī tángguǒ.
exampleSentences.english: The teacher says not to eat candy during class.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 奶奶給我一顆糖果，我好高興。
exampleSentences.pinyin: nǎinai gěi wǒ yì kē tángguǒ, wǒ hǎo gāoxìng.
exampleSentences.english: Grandma gave me a candy, and I'm so happy.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 生日派對上，朋友送我一包糖果。
exampleSentences.pinyin: shēngrì pàiduì shàng, péngyou sòng wǒ yì bāo tángguǒ.
exampleSentences.english: At my birthday party, a friend gave me a bag of candy.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我家的魚缸裡有一條魚。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ jiā de yúgāng lǐ yǒu yì tiáo yú.
exampleSentences.english: There is a fish in our fish tank.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 小魚在水裡游。
exampleSentences.pinyin: xiǎo yú zài shuǐ lǐ yóu.
exampleSentences.english: The little fish swims in the water.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我跟哥哥在海邊釣魚，釣到一條魚。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ gēn gēge zài hǎibiān diàoyú, diàodào yì tiáo yú.
exampleSentences.english: My brother and I go fishing at the beach and catch a fish.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 爸爸今晚煮了一條魚，很好吃。
exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba jīnwǎn zhǔ le yì tiáo yú, hěn hǎochī.
exampleSentences.english: Dad cooked a fish tonight, and it's delicious.
